backend/main.mo: Main Internet Computer actor defining NFT collections, items, user profiles, and issued NFTs with CRUD operations; enforces role-based access control via MixinAuthorization and includes blob storage via MixinStorage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (Mint NFT button, principal display, My NFTs filter, NFT card details) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and styles for the Istvan Seidel light-art NFT portfolio application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, charts, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light-art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, title, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, contact, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Admin form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using useCreateCollection and useUpdateCollection hooks with German-language labels and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of NFT collections with edit and delete actions for admin use, showing loading skeletons and a confirmation dialog before deletion.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT, supporting image upload with progress, collection selection, title, description, and ICP price fields.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnails, collection name, price badge, and edit/delete controls including a confirmation dialog for deletion.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, including hover zoom and shadow effects.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing image, token ID, owner, mint date, and optional highlighting if the NFT belongs to the current user.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main page layout wrapping children with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button) and a footer with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar component that renders route buttons for Home, NFT Gallery, Blog, Contact, and conditionally Upload and Admin links based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an NFT's image, title, collection name, price in ICP, and an optional ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component linking to an external NFT collection marketplace (Getgems), showing a collection image with loading/error states, title, description, and a trade link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven NFT collection cards (Getgems/TON blockchain) with titles, descriptions, and preview images.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal for an NFT showing its image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), copyable fields, and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section component with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helpers to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Displays an ICP principal address with optional shortening, a tooltip showing the full value, and a copy-to-clipboard button with toast feedback.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light, red light) with hardcoded content and timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend actor's addCollection method and invalidates the nft-collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls addNFT on the backend actor, then fetches the created NFT, with error parsing for authorization failures and cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection via the backend actor and invalidates both nft-collections and nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the nft-items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend with a no-op query for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old blog backend so static blog posts remain the only source.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued ICRC-7 NFTs via the backend actor's listAllNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFTItems from the backend actor using the nft-items cache key.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old single-artwork fetch for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-filtered artwork fetch.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null for a single blog post, deferring to static posts instead.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the currently authenticated user's profile from the backend actor, with combined loading state from both the actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's own issued NFTs via the backend actor's listMyNFTs method, enabled only when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFTItem by ID from the backend actor, enabled only when both the actor and ID are available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFTItems belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state management via DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the currently authenticated caller has admin privileges by calling the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the current user's profile to the backend and invalidates the user profile cache on success.
Stub mutation hook for a contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection via the backend actor and invalidates the collections cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an existing NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork uploads that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Custom hook that handles image file uploads to the backend actor with progress tracking, format validation, and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm art-themed light and dark color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only dashboard page with tabs for managing NFT collections and NFT items, including create and edit forms with auth guards.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message since the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as cards, and allows admins to create new posts.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image upload, redirecting non-admins to the blog listing.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Displays a single blog post by ID, merging static local posts with backend-fetched posts and showing title, date, featured image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook and shows success/error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page displaying a hero banner, a random Walter Russell quote, NFT collections, and an NFT explanation section.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT showing its image, title, description, collection badge, price, and a link to the ICP dashboard explorer.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: NFT gallery page with tabs for all NFTs and user-owned NFTs, wallet info display, canister address banner, and modals for minting and viewing NFT details.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React page for uploading and minting NFTs, allowing authenticated users to fill in metadata, select a collection, upload an image, and submit to the backend via the createNFT hook. Shows upload progress and a success state with an explorer link after minting.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID from either source, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Exports a single async function that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback to the legacy execCommand approach for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Provides helper functions to shorten an ICP principal string with ellipsis and to conditionally return the full or shortened form for display.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL bar without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Machine-readable project state file tracking the NFT gallery app's architecture, known issues, implemented features (minting, principal display, ownership filtering, NFT detail modal), and pending feature requests.
